repair: Evaluate norm/gate and out_proj for all three injected branches together using the model's original batch dimensions and unchanged module weights/forward implementations.
preservation: Remote run_injection.py and analysis/pilot.log retain the failed v1 source and log. Run v2 from run_injection_v2.py with analysis/pilot_v2.log.
scientific_semantics: Unchanged; same FP state, FP query/gate, observed Identity/Hadamard native-basis error vectors, and frozen downstream modules.
